title: CompileAgentContext
description: Request to compile the context the calling user's agent receives at one hook event, sent to `POST /v1/agentHarness/compile`.

compileEvent.description: Hook event context can be compiled for.

event.description: The hook event to compile for.

sessionId.description: The agent host's session id. Items sent once in a session are not sent again at UserPromptSubmit.

toolName.description: Name of the tool the agent is about to call or has called, for PreToolUse and PostToolUse.

toolInput.description: Input of the tool call as the agent host reports it, for PreToolUse.

maxTokens.description: Upper bound on the compiled text, for agent hosts that cap how much hook output the model sees. Items are dropped whole, persona items first, until the text fits. The event's own budget applies when it is lower.

toolOutput.description: Output of the tool call as the agent host reports it, for PostToolUse. Any JSON value.
